newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Hock Seng Lee to develop 3 bln rgt town.
newsitem.headline: Hock Seng Lee to develop 3 bln rgt town.

text.p: Malaysian marine engineering and reclamation company Hock Seng Lee Bhd said on Wednesday it proposes to develop an industrial township costing three billion ringgit ($1.21 billion).
The township is to be built near Kuching, capital of the eastern Malaysian state of Sarawak on Borneo island.

"Hock Seng Lee will be undertaking the turnkey land reclamation, infrastructure and construction works for a 3.0 billion ringgit modern industrial park and integrated township," said the company in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
Of the 3.0 billion ringgit, around 400 million is to be used for the reclamation of land from the sea, and 2.6 billion will be utilised in the construction works, said Hock Seng Lee.
The company did not specify how it would raise the funds for the project. Company officials could not be immediately contacted.
"We have received approval in principle for the proposal from the Sarawak Ministry of Industrial Development," said managing director Paul Yu Chee Hoe in the statement.
The initial reclamation works are expected to be completed within 36 months, said the company.
